definition.summary: Understand the reported change, stakeholders, direct consequences and uncertainty without forcing a positive or negative conclusion.

dimensions.name: Reported change
dimensions.description: What actually changed? Distinguish announcement, event date and publication date.
questions: What actually changed? Distinguish announcement, event date and publication date.

dimensions.name: Stakeholders
dimensions.description: Who is explicitly affected? Separate named groups from hypotheses.
questions: Who is explicitly affected? Separate named groups from hypotheses.

dimensions.name: Direct consequences
dimensions.description: What mechanism could create an effect, and under what conditions?
questions: What mechanism could create an effect, and under what conditions?

dimensions.name: Uncertainty
dimensions.description: What is unverified or missing? What evidence would change the conclusion?
questions: What is unverified or missing? What evidence would change the conclusion?

quality_criteria: Separate report claims, hypotheses and missing information.
Do not force opportunities, risks or findings for irrelevant dimensions.

dimensions.name: Messaging and channels

questions: What messaging or channel hypothesis follows from the evidence? Do not invent campaign budgets.

dimensions.name: Experiments
dimensions.description: What small experiment and observable metric could test a hypothesis? Never predict its result.

dimensions.name: Data and assets
dimensions.description: Which data or assets are explicitly involved? Do not assume the user company uses this system.
questions: Which data or assets are explicitly involved? Do not assume the user company uses this system.

dimensions.name: Exposure and access
dimensions.description: Is a change in exposure supported? A technology name alone is not a vulnerability.

dimensions.name: Dependencies
dimensions.description: Which supplier or infrastructure dependency is supported, and under what conditions?
questions: Which supplier or infrastructure dependency is supported, and under what conditions?

dimensions.name: Privacy

questions: What data transfer or retention is stated? Separate promised policy from verified implementation.

dimensions.name: Continuity

dimensions.name: Defensive checks
